label: Kimura fixation probability of a mutant allele
statement_en: The probability that a mutant allele eventually fixes in a finite population depends on its initial frequency, its selective advantage and the effective population size, and equals its initial frequency when it is neutral.

lean.source:
/-- **Neutral fixation probability (Kimura 1962, neutral case).** A neutral lineage that
starts with `i` of `M` copies is eventually fixed with probability `i / M`. -/
theorem fixedBy_tendsto (hM : 0 < M) (i : Fin (M + 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => C.fixedBy t i) atTop (𝓝 (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / M)) := by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρ1, hρ⟩ := C.fixedBy_sub_le hM
  rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  refine squeeze_zero (fun t => norm_nonneg _) (fun t => ?_)
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1)
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hρ t i

constraint_details.canEliminate: only a candidate that commits to a specific contradicting probability; it says nothing about which mutations arise or what they do
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C2, neutral fixation.** A candidate that confines the fixation probability of one new neutral
mutant among `M` copies to an interval not containing `1/M` is ruled out. -/
theorem neutral_fixation_rules_out (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) {a b : ℝ}
    (hu : a ≤ (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM) ∧
      (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM) ≤ b)
    (h : b < 1 / (M : ℝ) ∨ 1 / (M : ℝ) < a) : False := by
  rw [wrightFisher_fixation_one] at hu
  rcases h with h | h <;> linarith [hu.1, hu.2]
